messages.consent_required: To use this feature, please read and accept the consent first.
messages.consent_outdated: The consent for this feature has been updated. Please read the new version and accept it again.
messages.version_stale: This version of the consent is no longer current. Please read the new text and accept it again.
messages.signup_required: To create your account, please accept the Ritme terms and privacy policy and the processing of your health data first.

1.title: AI lab analysis
1.body: To read and explain a lab sheet, its photo or PDF is sent to an AI service.
points: Only the lab file and what the explanation needs (age, life stage, medications) are sent; names, mobile numbers and national IDs are removed from text.
If your name or other personal details are printed on the sheet, it is best to cover them before uploading.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
The result is not a substitute for a doctor's opinion.
You can withdraw this consent at any time in Privacy.

1.title: Assistant using your profile
1.body: For more accurate answers, the health assistant may see your age, life stage and medications.
points: Your name, mobile number and national ID are never sent.
You can chat with the assistant without this consent; answers are just more general.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

1.title: Help improve Ritme
1.body: Anonymous, aggregated statistics on how the app is used help us improve Ritme.
points: These statistics contain no health data and nothing that identifies you.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

1.title: Chat with the AI assistant
1.body: The messages and photos you send in a chat are sent to an AI service to answer you.
points: Names, mobile numbers and national IDs are removed from messages before they are sent.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
The assistant is not a doctor and does not diagnose; in an emergency call 115.
You can withdraw this consent at any time in Privacy.

1.title: Voice logging
1.body: Your recording is sent to an AI service to be turned into text and is deleted right after.
points: Neither the audio nor its transcript is stored; only what you confirm is logged.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

1.title: AI reading of medical documents
1.body: To fill in a document's fields automatically (such as date, centre and gestational age), its photo or PDF is sent to an AI service.
points: If your name or other personal details are printed on the document, it is best to cover them before uploading.
Fields read from the document are not saved until you confirm them.
The provider may not use this data to train its models.
You can withdraw this consent at any time.

1.title: Ritme terms and privacy
1.body: By accepting this text you agree to the Ritme terms of use and its privacy policy.
points: The full terms and privacy policy are always available in the app.
If these texts change, we show you the new version again.
Your acceptance is recorded with its date and text version; you can see the list in Privacy.

1.title: Processing your health data
1.body: Ritme processes the health data you enter yourself (such as periods, symptoms and pregnancy) to show you predictions and reminders.
points: This data is used only to provide the Ritme service to you.
It is not shared with anyone without your permission.
You can download your data or delete your account at any time.

1.title: What the assistant sees
1.body: The profile items you allowed the health assistant to see.

1.title: Data shared with a doctor
1.body: The data you shared with the doctor of one visit, for that visit.

1.title: Report link for a doctor
1.body: A link you created to view your health report.
